== Biography ==

Omaha is the birthplace of the Wizard, whose father, a politician, gave him the elaborate name Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkle Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs. After his balloon escaped too soon during his first departure with Dorothy, he was carried back alone to Omaha, where he found that all his old friends were dead or had moved away. With nothing else to do, he rejoined a circus there and resumed making balloon ascensions until an earthquake caught him. He also refers to a local expression, "as we say in Omaha," when describing how he directed the building of his domain.
